comments.content: BUG (correctness/contract): The async build(profile) method uses the profile parameter for root and scope resolution (path.resolve(profile.project.root), resolveGraphifyOut(profile), profile.graph?.scope) but NEVER assigns it to this.profile. All subsequent query methods — whoCalls, imports, awaits, unwired — and buildSync reference this.profile.project.root and this.profile.graph?.scope for fallback file paths and scope filtering. If build is called with a profile different from the constructor's, these queries use a stale profile, producing incorrect fallback anchors and potentially wrong scope-filtering results. Fix: add this.profile = profile at the start of build.

comments.content: BUG (latent correctness): In normalizeGraphifyGraph, the containment pass loops for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) and accesses rawNodes[i]. However, nodes was built by filtering out null/non-object rows from rawNodes. When any rows are dropped, nodes[i] does NOT correspond to rawNodes[i] — the indices are misaligned. This means nodeIdByRaw.get(rawNodes[i]) in the containment loop looks up the wrong raw record (or a null), producing incorrect map lookups. The effect is currently masked because the nodeIdByRaw.set on the next line sets the same id value (no-op), but the code is fragile. Fix: build a parallel array of raw records that aligns with nodes, or track the raw index alongside the node.

comments.content: BUG (dependency injection): resolveGraphifyBinary computes env.PATH ?? process.env.PATH ?? ''. If a custom env object is passed that lacks a PATH key, the function silently falls back to the real process.env.PATH instead of respecting the injected environment. This defeats dependency injection and can produce non-deterministic PATH resolution in tests or isolated environments. Fix: use env.PATH ?? '' without falling back to process.env.

comments.content: PERFORMANCE/MAINTAINABILITY: scopeBuildToProfile canonicalizes the root via fs.realpathSync(root) and then passes rootCanon to containedRel, which calls fs.realpathSync(rootCanon) again on the already-canonicalized path. This is a redundant syscall on every invocation. Since rootCanon is already canonical, containedRel should skip the root realpath or accept an already-canonical flag. The same double-realpath pattern appears in projectGraphifyGraph.

comments.content: MAINTAINABILITY: Three divergent implementations of root-relative containment/realpath logic exist: (1) containedRel helper, (2) the inline containment block in normalizeGraphifyGraph using path.relative + startsWith checks, and (3) the inScope helper in scopeBuildToProfile wrapping containedRel. The containment checks differ slightly (normalizeGraphifyGraph checks rel !== '' && rel !== '..' && !startsWith '..', while containedRel checks rel.length === 0 || split('/').includes('..')). Consolidate into a single shared utility to avoid drift.
